name: program-runtime.supervision-sweep
purpose: Read fleet lifecycle state once and report running/health for a named delivery-scenario set, naming any that are not running or not healthy, so a supervisor runs one program instead of one status call per scenario.

all_scenarios.description: When true, return one bounded summary for every scenario in the fleet instead of filtering a named set.

page_size.description: Rows per all_scenarios page, capped at 20 to fit the default 4 KB output tier.

scenarios.description: Comma-separated scenario slugs to supervise. Named requests return one bounded {name,status,health} row per requested slug in request order; absent or unobserved slugs use absent or unknown labels. Defaults to the delivery/product scenario set.

assumptions: the vrooli project control-plane API is reachable (the process that serves vrooli/scenario/list)
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
exactly one governed read (vrooli/scenario/list) is issued; no per-scenario fan-out
filter named requests before materializing at most 32; all_scenarios materializes at most 160 fleet rows and reports incomplete coverage beyond the bound
named requests return one name/status/health row per requested slug including absent or unknown rows, trimming only the returned suffix when needed to stay under 4 KB
named request envelopes never exceed the 4 KB output bound
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
at most 32 named scenarios or 160 all-fleet summaries are reported; incomplete coverage is marked partial

signals.requested: count of scenario slugs supervised after truncation
signals.found: count of requested slugs present in the fleet list
signals.running: count of requested scenarios whose lifecycle status is running
signals.healthy: count of requested scenarios whose health is healthy
signals.attention: list of {name, status, health} for requested scenarios that are not running or not healthy, plus any requested slug absent from the fleet list
signals.scenarios: for named requests, {name, status, health} rows in request order; the output may truncate a suffix; for all_scenarios=true, one page of fleet rows
signals.page_offset: offset consumed for the returned page
signals.page_size: bounded maximum rows in the page
signals.total_scenarios: number of fleet rows materialized within the 160-row bound
signals.next_offset: next page offset, or null when all rows have been returned
signals.truncated: true when more than 32 slugs were requested or named rows were trimmed to meet the output bound
signals.source_truncated: true when matching fleet rows exceed the bounded materialization

fixtures.note: Requires the project control-plane API serving vrooli/scenario/list. When that endpoint is down the program returns status unavailable with reason scenario_unreachable; that is the honest sensor result, not a program defect.
An empty scenario set after trimming is an invalid input the program reports as failed with class invalid_input before any read.
